title: Building the Digital Architecture to Deliver Intelligent CMC Workflows Intelligent workflows in Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) leverage artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML),... Read more
content: Intelligent workflows in Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) leverage artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and automation to transform traditionally document-centric, siloed processes into data-driven, accelerated, and compliant operations. These workflows address the increasing complexity of regulatory dossiers and manufacturing, aiming to reduce development timelines and improve product quality Workflow orchestration – unifying process development, manufacturing, analytics and regulatory filing processes Power of ontologies and data models in workflow orchestration, enabling controlled vocabularies and dictionaries for enabling search, reuse, and consistent reporting Connecting software systems, instruments, equipment, IOT and people to create contextualized knowledge Register for Premium Content Phone This field is for validation purposes and should be left unchanged.
